premises.text: International payments are a necessity for many entrepreneurs and creators to reach their full potential
premises.evidence_span: international payments are a necessity for many entrepreneurs and creators like Sandra to reach their full potential

premises.text: Integrating with multiple payment APIs is complex and time-consuming
premises.evidence_span: the process of integrating with multiple payment APIs in different countries is incredibly complex. It is time-consuming and leads to higher transaction fees

premises.text: Many digital entrepreneurs face significant barriers to entry due to payment integration complexities
premises.evidence_span: this alone creates a significant barrier to entry to over 195 million digital entrepreneurs globally

premises.text: Mainstack provides a unified API ecosystem that simplifies payment integration for non-technical users
premises.evidence_span: Mainstack provides a unified and robust API ecosystem that abstracts the complexity of integrating with multiple payment platforms

premises.text: Mainstack enables users to receive payments without writing code
premises.evidence_span: enabling non-technical entrepreneurs and creators to get access to global payment options without writing any single line of code

premises.text: Mainstack's platform allows users to select currencies and generate checkout links
premises.evidence_span: she can now go to her dashboard on Mainstack to generate a checkout link to offer multiple global payment options via her own website

premises.text: Mainstack has a solid backend infrastructure that facilitates quick startup for users
premises.evidence_span: Mainstack has built a solid backend infrastructure that has made it easier for entrepreneurs and creators like Sandra to get started in minutes

premises.text: Mainstack is experiencing significant growth and is used in many countries
premises.evidence_span: Mainstack is currently being used in over 127 countries as I speak on this stage

value.text: Entrepreneurs and creators can showcase their work and receive payments easily and securely
value.evidence_span: showcase their work and receive payments via websites, storefronts, invoicing, MediaKit, and more
